text 9e0001 The reads are done. Every file the loader touches was read once, and the policy keeps its mode while the ledger writes one row for each decision it makes on the way. The lock is read before the mode, so an enforced policy without a valid lock resolves to shadow and says so in the row it writes. The wire declares its own limits and the caller reads them, so no request cap is invented here. A timeout, a refusal or an oversize request each return ask and never allow, and the row records the build the response reported. The state hash and the state builder version sit beside the distribution, and the outcome slot stays empty until the turn that used the verdict ends. Nothing in the policy reads a clock, a file or the network, and every threshold comes from library data rather than a literal. The three folders below are the ones the session can open next.

text 9e0002 Pick F:\work\projects\gobta-zed for the game.
call r507 read c.go

text 9e0003 Once a folder is picked the session opens it, reads its rules and its board, and starts the next turn there. The other two folders stay where they are and nothing in them is read until one of them is picked in a later turn. Say the folder by its path or by its place in the list and the lead opens it the same way.
